title: Rounding to Fourier granularity
statement: For a natural number $k$ and a rational number $q$, round $q$ divided by the degree-$k$ Fourier granularity to the nearest integer, then multiply by that granularity. (The defining construction of the degree-$k$ Fourier granularity is not included in the supplied statement.)
